requirement: The system shall refuse to register a new claim against a policy that has lapsed or been cancelled.
The system shall compute the payable amount for a claim as the assessed loss minus the policy excess, capped at the sum insured.
The customer submits a new claim by entering the incident details and uploading supporting evidence; the system validates and records it as registered.
The system shall route a newly registered claim to the appropriate assessor queue based on claim type and loss amount band.
As a claims handler, I want to search claims by policy number or claimant name so that I can locate the case I am working on.
As a policyholder, I want to view the status and history of my claims so that I can follow their progress.
As a claims assessor, I want to record a decision to approve, decline or refer a claim so that the claimant is informed and next steps are triggered.
A claim may only be approved for payment when all mandatory supporting documents have been received and the fraud screening has cleared.
Every change to a claim decision, assessed amount or payment must be recorded with the old value, the new value, the actor and the time.
The claim table shall ensure that the loss date is not in the future, that the assessed loss is non-negative and that the claim status is one of the recognised values.
code:
-- claim table for the insurance system
CREATE TABLE claim (
    claim_id         BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    claim_reference  VARCHAR(40)    NOT NULL,
    policy_number    VARCHAR(40)    NOT NULL,
    claimant_id      VARCHAR(40)    NOT NULL,
    claim_type       VARCHAR(30)    NOT NULL,
    loss_date        DATE           NOT NULL,
    reported_at      TIMESTAMP      NOT NULL,
    assessed_loss    NUMERIC(12,2),
    status           VARCHAR(20)    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT claim_policy_fk     FOREIGN KEY (policy_number) REFERENCES policy(policy_number),
    CONSTRAINT claim_reference_unique UNIQUE (claim_reference),
    CONSTRAINT claim_loss_not_future CHECK (loss_date <= CURRENT_DATE),
    CONSTRAINT claim_assessed_nonneg CHECK (assessed_loss IS NULL OR assessed_loss >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT claim_status_chk      CHECK (status IN ('REGISTERED','ASSESSING','APPROVED','DECLINED','REFERRED','SETTLED','CLOSED'))
);

CREATE INDEX claim_policy_idx ON claim (policy_number, status);
hard_negatives:
-- policy master table
CREATE TABLE policy (
    policy_number   VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
    policyholder_id VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    product_code    VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    cover_start     DATE          NOT NULL,
    cover_end       DATE          NOT NULL,
    sum_insured     NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    excess          NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT policy_dates_order CHECK (cover_end > cover_start),
    CONSTRAINT policy_sum_positive CHECK (sum_insured > 0)
);
-- claim payment table
CREATE TABLE claim_payment (
    payment_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    claim_id        BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    amount          NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    paid_at         TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    payment_method  VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT payment_claim_fk FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES claim(claim_id),
    CONSTRAINT payment_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0)
);

requirement: Only claims handlers assigned to a claim may make decisions on it; a supervisor may override the restriction only with an explicit override role.
The month-end settlement batch shall produce a payment file of all approved claims due for payment in the period, excluding claims on hold or pending fraud review.
